content: सूना [सुञः नः दीर्घश्च <ls>Uṇ. 3. 13</ls>] .²1 A slaughter-house, butcherʼs house; भवानपि सूनोपरिचर इव गृध्र आमिषलोलुपो भीरुकश्च <ls>M. 2</ls>. .²2 The sale of meat. .²3 Hurting, killing, destroying; सूनायामप्यननुमतमालम्भनं तदुपलभ्य <ls>Bhāg. 5. 9. 17</ls>. .²4 The soft palate, uvula. .²5 A girdle, zone. .²6 Inflammation of the gland of the neck called mumps. .²7 A ray of light. .²8 A river. .²9 A daughter. .²10 An elephantʼs trunk. .{@-नाः@} ({%f.%} <ab>pl.</ab>) The five things in a house by which animal life is likely to be destroyed; see under शूना or पञ्चशूना.
